Anna — great to hear, excited to partner. Short answers up front and a proposed next step below.

Minimum-viable integration:
- One POST /embed endpoint from RetailSync to Redwood (retail batch + per-transaction streaming)
- One /rank endpoint to return top-N recommendations with scores
- Auth: API keys scoped to the customer + optional signed JWTs for marketplace flow

Marketplace route:
- Recommend private offer via AWS Marketplace for POC (faster procurement + co-sell attribution). We can also stage an Azure listing later if you want multi-cloud.

Security evidence:
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II summary, network diagrams, and data flow notes. If you need a hurtable artifact (penetration test or full architecture), we can scope it.

Proposed MAP (first pass):
1) Tech discovery call (this week) — owner: Marcus (integrations) — target: 30–60 min
2) Exchange MAP template + SOW redlines — owner: Naomi / Anna — 3 business days
3) Marketplace intake + private offer setup — owner: Karthik — dependent on procurement
4) Security evidence handoff — owner: Security (cc'd when needed)

I've attached our MAP template for quick completion. Can Marcus lead the technical call? Ben, can you join to flag listing entitlements/credits?

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_MAP_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
